extracted.notes: 2024-25 cycle (Class of 2029 / Fall 2024 enrollment data). No 2025-26 CDS published as of June 2026. Accept rate: 3,968 admitted / 33,283 applicants = 11.92%. 2025-26 CDS confirmed published at Georgetown OADS (oads.georgetown.edu/commondataset/). Georgetown requires standardized testing (not test-optional). Level of applicant interest is explicitly 'Not Considered' per CDS C7.

2025-26 CDS PDF confirmed live at Emory's official provost IR page. After four targeted searches — including juilliard.edu site searches, direct CDS PDF queries, and third-party mirrors — no official Common Data Set document (any year) could be located for The Juilliard School. Juilliard does not appear to publish a CDS on its institutional research or admissions pages. As a conservatory whose admissions are almost entirely audition-driven, it likely does not participate in the CDS initiative, or its filings are not publicly posted. IPEDS data (2023 cycle via DataUSA) shows ~2,020 undergrad applicants and ~181 admitted (~8.96% rate), but this is IPEDS-derived, not from a CDS, and cannot be used to populate the required CDS fields with 'high' confidence. All fields are null per instructions to never invent values.

CRITICAL: Colby College has not publicly released a CDS document since the 2015-2016 cycle. Their institutional research page (colby.edu/institutionalresearch/dataset/) only hosts files through 2015-16. No 2024-25 or 2025-26 official CDS PDF was locatable. USNA does not publish a standard Common Data Set document. The IR page (usna.edu/IR) and admissions pages do not host a CDS PDF or equivalent form. Data is drawn from the USNA Class Portrait for the Class of 2029 (Fall 2024 entry, 2024-25 cycle). Accept rate of 8.81% is from Class Portrait (1,416 admitted / 16,077 applicants), corroborated by AdmissionSight citing USNA data. SAT sub-scores for Class of 2029 are Verbal 600-710 and Math 610-720 per a service-academy admissions site citing the USNA Class Portrait; composite 25th (~1210) and 75th (~1430) are derived sums of sub-score band endpoints, NOT directly read from a CDS C9 table. USNA reports ACT by section only, not as a composite, so act_25 and act_75 are null. All C7 factors are null because USNA does not publish a C7-format factor-importance grid in any CDS document. Confidence is low because no official CDS document exists to read directly.
